reads.name: Rocco Arena, b. 20 December 1861
reads.father: Francesco Antonio Arena, 42, marinaro, son of Filippo
reads.note: ACT READ IN FULL. Declared 23 December 1861 at Scilla, Distretto di Reggio, by the father himself. Witnesses Giuseppe Idone, 64, and Francesco Antonio Poli, 70, proprietario. The parish note records the baptism of Rocco Arena on the 23rd. Gives THREE generations: Filippo Arena, his son Francesco Antonio (b. c.1819, a SAILOR), and Rocco.

reads.name: Arena Domenica
reads.note: Another Arena birth at Scilla in 1861, not in the family tree. Parentage not read — see the correction note below before trusting any parents column read off this index.

correction.what: This archive read the 1861 index as giving Rocco Arena's parents as «Giuseppe e Zirilli Grazia». The act says Francesco Antonio Arena and Serafina Arlotta. The index's parents column had been misaligned by one row.
correction.why: The Scilla index is a wide ruled table photographed across a gutter, and the row a name sits on is not always the row its parents sit on once the columns are cropped apart. The fix is to read the act, which is what the entry was flagged for.
correction.lesson: It was recorded as a CANDIDATE, not a join, precisely because the forenames did not match the family tree — and that caution is what caught it. Had it been merged on the surname agreement alone, the archive would now carry a wrong set of great-great-grandparents.

conflict.tree: Rocco Arena b. 1861, son of ORAZIO ARENA and GIOVANA ZIRILLI
conflict.register: Rocco Arena b. 20 December 1861, son of FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA, marinaro, and SERAFINA ARLOTTA
conflict.reading: The 1861 Scilla register contains exactly one Rocco Arena and neither parent matches the tree. Either the tree's parents are wrong, or its birth year is — and this archive has already found that tree six years out on Salvatore Mazza's birth and six on Orazio Mazza's. The year is the likelier error. Unresolved either way.
